decisions.quote: The effect of the acoustic stimuli and of information was weak. Failure to replicate previous findings of decreased pain by weak prepulses was most likely due to the sensory modality of the prepulse stimuli.
decisions.reason: No prior adjudication or state files exist for this request. The available source text is an abstract only (evidence_level: abstract) with no in-text citations or reference list. While the abstract explicitly states an empirical retest ('Failure to replicate previous findings of decreased pain by weak prepulses'), the abstract alone provides no bibliographic identity for the retested study and cannot verify whether the original finding is already fully represented by shipped row 1850 (Blumenthal, Burnett, & Swerdlow, 2001, 10.1097/00006842-200103000-00012) or involves additional or different original papers.
